## Public contracts

These are what people build automation on. Tick what still holds, and say
below what changed if something does not.

- [ ] **Exit codes** unchanged — `0` nothing pending, `1` updates available,
      `2` error; under `--yes`, `0` all updates ran and `2` any failed
- [ ] **`--json` shape** unchanged — `{ engine: { kind, model, label },
      missingUsagePaths, reports[] }`
- [ ] **Config format** unchanged — `usagePaths`, and
      `tools[].{ name, source, version: { cmd, match }, update }`
- [ ] **Existing `version.match` patterns still resolve** — configs in the
      wild contain regexes generated by earlier versions, so a change to how
      `confirmProbe` builds them must not break the ones already written
- [ ] **Source forms** unchanged — `github:owner/repo`,
      `codeberg:owner/repo`, and full forge URLs
- [ ] **CLI surface** unchanged — `init`, `add`, `scan`, and the flags in
      `--help`
- [ ] **No new runtime dependency** — the tool imports nothing outside Node's
      standard library, and there is no build step
